messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — post-deploy synthetic in eu-west just started failing 503s and we see a concurrent CPU surge on the inference pool. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/eu/smoke (p95 spike). :eyes:

Deploy-bot: deploy-2871 succeeded in eu-west at 2779001210. Running postdeploy-smoke (fanout=100%). 10 failing probes detected.

Raj: Do we have a quick rollback plan? sounds like the synth fanout is the culprit.

Olivia: I don't think rollback first — looks like the new routing change increased synth fanout to backends that can't handle the burst. Proposal: reduce fanout to 10% for synth agents, pin routing to model-v2.0 for eu-west while we investigate.

Matt: Agree with throttling. Also we can switch synth probes to hit quantized variant (model-v2.0-q4) which reduces per-request GPU usage by ~40% — lower perf but should keep smoke green.

Sara: +1 to pin + throttle. Avoid rollback unless we see user-facing errors or error budget burn. Can you do a quick impact check on longer tails?

Olivia: quick check: user traffic looks fine, no 5xx from production routes. Only synth is failing and causing queueing. I'll apply throttles and pin for eu-west first.

Deploy-bot: Executing config change: 
```
PATCH /config/synth-agent
{"region":"eu-west","fanout_pct":10,"probe_target":"model-v2.0-q4","pin_version":"model-v2.0"}
```
Change applied by olivia at 2779001251.

Raj: Nice. After change, can we re-run a smaller smoke run (30 probes) and watch KV caches + prefix miss?

Olivia: Running 30-probe smoke now.

Deploy-bot: Synthetic run: 30 probes, 0 failures, p95 latency reduced 35% vs failing run.

Matt: Looks stable. I'll leave a note to follow-up with model-team on the routing heuristic that caused the fanout. Might be the new multi-variant router rule.

Sara: Can we avoid a full rollback and instead put a short item on the postmortem board and update release notes? also add a brief mitigation doc with the config snippet.

Olivia: Will update release notes and create a short incident ticket for routing heuristic + add unit test for synth fanout threshold.

Oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Incident ticket created: INC-2026. Assigned to matt and olivia.

Raj: Thanks — agreed no rollback. If we see production error rate >0.5% in next 15m we call rollback.

Olivia: Copy that. Monitoring for 15m, will escalate if any regressions. :thumbsup:
